name: grpo_rev
note: Grasp the green cube by moving the end-effector to its plan_grasp pose (using that pose's full orientation), close the gripper and lift; then translate so the grasped green cube's center is directly above the red cube's center (the cube center is offset from the end-effector, so move to align the cube, not the end-effector, over the red cube) and lower gently to place it.
